hero.lead: Put your business growth on autopilot. AI-crafted posts, automated scheduling, and direct Meta publishing.
hero.lead2: Marketing agency in a box: social posts, marketing plans, organic Google growth, smart paid-budget split and WhatsApp lead capture. All in one place.
hero.note: No credit card. Nothing is published without your approval.
f.sub: Everything an agency does, without the meetings and the wait.
f1.p: Posts, carousels and scheduling for Facebook and Instagram, in your brand's voice.
f2.p: Every week, posts are ready for quick approval. You approve, the system schedules.
f3.p: A brand website and SEO articles written for your business and submitted to Google.
f4.p: Budget split across channels by what brings leads at a lower cost, explained in plain language.
f5.p: Every inquiry reaches you instantly with call and WhatsApp buttons.
f6.p: Impressions, leads and budget split, and what changed and why.
h1.t: Sign up and set up your business
h1.p: Name, what you sell and to whom. The system builds your brand voice.
h2.p: One click, through Facebook's official login.
h3.p: Review the posts, approve, and the system schedules and publishes.
p.sub: Start free and upgrade when you need. Prices shown include VAT: exactly what is charged to your card.
q1.a: Correct. Autopilot only prepares drafts for approval. Publishing happens after you approve.
q2.a: Each AI action (post, plan, campaign) costs one credit. Business plans are not limited by credits.
q3.a: Creator plans: any time. Business plans carry a 12-month commitment.
q4.q: Is my data separate from other customers?
q4.a: Yes. Every business has fully separate data, and you can delete your account and all data in one click.
